title: Application are invited for Training Programme on Pharmacovigilance for NABH Accredited Hospitals at Sher-i-Kashmir Institute of Medical Sciences, Soura, Srinagar, J&K on 23rd October 2026
bodyHtml:
Application are invited for Training Programme on Pharmacovigilance for NABH Accredited Hospitals at Sher-i-Kashmir Institute of Medical Sciences, Soura, Srinagar, J&K on 23rd October 2026

Mode: Physical Mode

Registration Fee: Rs. 1000/-

Last Date of Registration: 20th October, 2026

Organized By: National Coordination Centre- Pharmacovigilance Programme of India, Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission in collaboration with NABH and SKIMS, Hospital, Soura, Srinagar, J&K

Online Registration Link: https://forms.gle/6rEpz4uRfnCzR16u7 (opens in a new tab)
